quarterly_data.quarter: MKS Instruments press release: MKS Inc. to Sell Its Ophir Optics Business to TTM (10-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: MKS entered into a definitive agreement (announced October 19, 2026) to sell its Ophir Optics business to TTM Technologies in an all-cash transaction. Ophir Optics provides high-precision infrared thermal imaging and laser optics solutions to customers in MKS' Specialty Industrial market, serving defense, security and industrial applications. The sale excludes the MKS Ophir Instruments laser characterization business (laser power measurement and beam profiler solutions, core to its photonics solutions portfolio), which operates separately, and the Ophir brand; MKS says there will be no impact on the products, services and support it provides to Ophir Instruments customers. Closing is expected in the second quarter of 2027, subject to customary closing conditions including certain regulatory approvals and governmental consents and permits. CEO John T.C. Lee: the Ophir Optics business highlights how MKS can apply its technology capabilities to serve attractive opportunities outside its core Semiconductor and Electronics & Packaging markets, and TTM is well positioned to support the business in its next phase of growth.
quarterly_data.figure: Ophir Optics sale to TTM Technologies; closing expected in the second quarter of 2027
